'''Rwookrrorro''' was the [[capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee]]s.<ref name="BMF 43" /> An inland [[tree]] [[city]]<ref name="TOG">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> located several hundred [[kilometer]]s of [[Kachirho]], in an area of exceptionally tall [[wroshyr tree]]s,<ref name="CVD" /> Rwookrrorro reached up through the canopies. Therefore, it was visible to approaching [[starship]]s, unlike most Wookiee cities and other settlements, which were largely hidden. The [[spaceport]], located on the fringes of the city, was one of the few structures where metal was used more than wood.<ref name="Collapse">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref>

It was the birth place of the Wookiees [[Chewbacca]]<ref name="CVD" /> and [[Sagwa]],<ref name="Sagwa">{{Databank|sagwa|Sagwa}}</ref> who protected its people from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[soldier]]s being he was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] and [[Slavery|enslaved]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Attichitcuk]], [[Chewbacca's mother]], and several of Chewbacca's cousins lived in Rwookrrorro.<ref name="CVD" />
